data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (Flights tab, trip type, origin and destination, date, passengers, Search, sort by Fastest, See flight, Select, Next) and names the right core parameters, but it adds a direct-flights filter and a ticket-type choice that the true run doesn't show, and it omits the second leg for multi-city trips and a general filters parameter, so an automation would need some guesswork.
